match.subject: promo_code
match.key: Task 1: purchase dispute: promo code invalid.

args.question: Is the customer's promo code invalid claim a company error?

guards.why: policies/membership: level may get a new code and system confirms company error

reply:
Hi {{s.pull_up_account.account.name|first}}, thanks for your patience!

I looked into the promo code issue on your account, and I'm sorry for the trouble. As a valued {{s.membership.level}} member, I've gone ahead and issued you a brand-new code: **{{s.promo_code.code}}**, good for {{s.promo_code.percent}}% off your next purchase. It's valid through {{s.promo_code.expires}} — just enter it at checkout. (Promo codes are only good for 7 days after they're issued, so an older code will show as invalid.)

Is there anything else I can help you with today?
